## Purpose
The Tool Service's LLM access. Every model call goes through `complete`, addressed by a role ("codegen", "repair", "arbiter", …) that resolves to a `ModelRoute` (model, reasoning effort, timeout, fallback).

## Responsibilities
Re-exports `complete`, `complete_json`, `LLMUnavailable`, `ModelRoute` and `route_for`.
